system.description:
[Trigger: Action] Used at the same time as "Basic Weapon Attack". Consumes one [Potion] you have available as a cost. The target you damaged with "Basic Weapon Attack" also receives the effect of the consumed [Potion]. Once per scene.[Trigger: Rest Time & Fate 1] You gain one general item with the [IR] or lower [Potion] tag that you can use. A venomous-looking leather whip shaped like a viper. The snake-head piece at its tip injects poison into the enemy with each strike. The poison runs out after one use, but after a while the whip is somehow refilled with a poison of the effect its wielder desires.

[Core Material](300G)+ (220G)+[ 12](150G)×4+Crafting Cost(430G)
